CustomField.label: Formula
CustomField.description: For a formula column: a Salesforce formula, in the syntax of formula fields, that the grid works out for each row when the rows are read. A formula column has no Field API Name, needs a Column Label, is Text when Formula Type is blank, and is read only.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A formula, as in a formula field, worked out for each row. Leave Field API Name blank.
